late_deliveries.policy: Orders delayed past the expected delivery date by 1 to 5 days receive a $10 courtesy credit or free expedited shipping on the next order. Orders delayed by more than 7 days are eligible for a full shipping fee refund and an optional full order cancellation with a 100% refund if the package has not arrived.

damaged_products.policy: Customers reporting damaged goods within 14 days of receipt are eligible for an immediate replacement at zero cost or a 100% full refund upon photo verification of damage.

refunds_and_returns.policy: Standard items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in unused condition. Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days after inspection at our warehouse.

missing_items.policy: If an item is missing from a delivered package, notify support within 7 days for priority reshipment of the missing item or a pro-rated refund.

cancellations.policy: Orders can be canceled for a full refund if requested before the status moves to 'Shipped' or 'In Transit'.

payment_problems.policy: Duplicate charges or payment failures require verification with the payment processor. Refunds for duplicate charges are issued within 2 business days upon confirmation.
